title: T21 PR 3: chat threads in a left rail
head: t21-chat-rail
body:
## What

Last PR of T21 Chat threads (decisions #67, #68, #71, #72); service side is `agent-core` 0.6.12-0.6.14 (`agent-core#27`, `#28`, `#29`, all merged).

`docs/local-api.md`: new Chats section copied from `agent-core` `docs/local-service.md`: `GET /chats`, `POST /chats`, `GET /chats/search?q=`, `GET /chats/:id`, `POST /chats/:id/rename`, two-call `POST /chats/:id/delete` (first call returns `needs_confirmation` + `preview` + `confirm_token`; second call with `confirm_token` returns `deleted`; 409 `confirmation_invalid` or `paused`). `WS /chat` send carries `thread_id`; done echoes `thread_id`; no `thread_id` means newest thread (#71).

`src/lib/serviceClient.ts`: typed functions for each Chats endpoint; `thread_id` on the chat socket send and done event.

New `src/components/ChatRail.tsx`, shown beside the chat in `src/App.tsx`: search box, New chat, thread list newest first, click to resume, inline rename (Enter saves, Escape cancels), delete shows the preview lines with Yes and Cancel; only the Yes click sends the `confirm_token`. After the first reply's done the list re-fetches so the auto-title shows. When the window is shown again (Ctrl+Space, focus or visibilitychange) the list re-fetches and the newest thread is selected. Rust is unchanged; Ctrl+Space keeps its show/hide toggle. Every request path shows a plain message on failure.

`src/components/Chat.tsx` takes `threadId`, `initialMessages` and `onDone`; the history resets when the thread changes.

`tests/fakeService.ts` serves the same Chats contract in memory, including the one-time delete token, and records every delete call.

`tests/ChatRail.test.tsx` (12 cases) and `tests/Chat.test.tsx` (resume round trip).

`CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased entry; `docs/rig.md` describes the rail. No version bump (repo stays 0.1.0). No leftover `Btabor11/` links in this repo.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator after integrate)

- `npm run typecheck`: clean
- `npx eslint src tests`: clean
- `vitest` 15 files, 78 tests passed
- `cargo check` and `cargo test` passed
- `git diff --check` clean

## Delete gate mutation check

Each mutant was applied to `ChatRail.tsx` alone and `tests/ChatRail.test.tsx` re-run; every one made a test fail:

1. preview call sends the token straight away with no Yes
2. Cancel sends the token
3. Yes sends a wrong token
4. Yes sends the token twice
5. Yes skips the confirm call but removes the row

No surviving mutants.

## After merge

- Restart rig-service on `agent-core` main (0.6.14) and rebuild OASIS.app on Braden's Mac
- Braden checks that a thread survives a restart, resumes from the rail, and is deleted only after a Yes
- That closes T21.
